findings.title: ModelNotFoundError message is missing its opening quote around the model name
findings.anchor: `${name}" not found in catalog. Use model names from the catalog (e.g., "WHISPER_TINY", "EMBEDDINGGEMMA_300M_Q4_0")`
findings.evidence: get-model-info.ts:40-42 builds the message from the template `${name}" not found in catalog...`. It has a closing `"` after the interpolated name but no opening one, unlike the quoted examples in the same string.
findings.impact: Anyone calling getModelInfo with an unknown name gets a malformed error such as `FOO" not found in catalog. ...`. Tests or callers that match on the message text see the wrong string.
findings.reproduction: Call handleGetModelInfo({ type: 'getModelInfo', name: 'FOO' }) and read error.message. It starts with `FOO" not found` instead of `"FOO" not found`.
findings.fix: Change the template to `"${name}" not found in catalog. ...`.
